name: Nagao (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Nagao town emblem in white: a stylised device of a downward triangle and curved horns, like a bird.
history: Flag of the former town of Nagao in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2002-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in April 1960.

features.role: Nagao town emblem — a stylised device of a downward triangle and curved horns, like a bird
